dialogues.jp: 「うーん……まあ、大丈夫かな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... I guess I'm okay."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... I guess I'm okay."

dialogues.jp: 部屋の真ん中で屈伸運動してみる。
dialogues.en:
I stretched out in the middle of my room. It's been a week
since I got out of the hospital. My leg should be healed by
now.
dialogues.text:
I stretched out in the middle of my room. It's been a week
since I got out of the hospital. My leg should be healed by
now.

dialogues.jp:
退院から今日で１週間。予定では治っていても
おかしくないハズだ。
dialogues.en: "It doesn't hurt any more. I think I'm good now."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't hurt any more. I think I'm good now."

dialogues.jp: 「痛くないし、もういいかな」
dialogues.en: I left my crutches in my room and went downstairs.
dialogues.text: I left my crutches in my room and went downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの、松葉杖はどうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Where are your crutches?"
dialogues.text: "Where are your crutches?"

dialogues.jp:
のんびりと朝の支度をしていた萌先輩が、俺を
見て困惑した表情を見せる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai asked me with a concerned face as soon as she saw
me.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai asked me with a concerned face as soon as she saw
me.

dialogues.jp: 「さほど痛くもないし、部屋に置いてきました」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't hurt any more, so I left them in my room."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't hurt any more, so I left them in my room."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「もう、本当に大丈夫なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you're okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you're okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
いつまでもあんなのを使ってたら、面倒臭くっ
てたまったもんじゃない。
dialogues.en: I can't use them for too long. They're so bothering to me.
dialogues.text: I can't use them for too long. They're so bothering to me.

dialogues.jp: 「今日からは自分で鞄を持ちますよ」
dialogues.en: "I can hold my own bag from now on."
dialogues.text: "I can hold my own bag from now on."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか……でも、あまり無理はなさらな
　いでくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Really? ......Please take it easy, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Really? ......Please take it easy, okay?"

dialogues.jp:
不安を拭いきれない表情のまま、萌先輩は朝食
の準備に戻っていった。
dialogues.en:
Moe went back to preparing breakfast with the concerned
expression still on her face.
dialogues.text:
Moe went back to preparing breakfast with the concerned
expression still on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「本当にそれ、持って行くんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you really going to take those?"
dialogues.text: "Are you really going to take those?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩の手には、俺の松葉杖が
握られていた。
dialogues.en: She smiled softly as she held my crutches in her hands.
dialogues.text: She smiled softly as she held my crutches in her hands.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「もし、また足が痛くなったら、ないと困りま
　すから」
dialogues.en: "You'll need these if your leg starts hurting again."
dialogues.text: "You'll need these if your leg starts hurting again."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、そうだけど……」
dialogues.en: "You're right, but......"
dialogues.text: "You're right, but......"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は両手で松葉杖を持ちながら、よたよた
と歩きだす。
dialogues.en:
Moe started staggering as she held the crutches in both
hands.
dialogues.text:
Moe started staggering as she held the crutches in both
hands.

dialogues.jp:
はたから見ると、とても妙なカップルに見える
と思う。
dialogues.en: I bet we look like a strange couple from the outside.
dialogues.text: I bet we look like a strange couple from the outside.

dialogues.jp:
俺は自分と｛・・・・・／萌先輩の鞄｝を持ちなおすと、あと
を追った。
dialogues.en: I followed her as I held both of our bags.
dialogues.text: I followed her as I held both of our bags.

dialogues.jp: ◆松葉杖◆
dialogues.en: ◆Crutches◆
dialogues.text: ◆Crutches◆

dialogues.jp:
退院してから一週間。そろそろ、松葉杖がなく
ても大丈夫になった。
dialogues.en:
It's been a week since I was released from the hospital. I
can walk without my crutches now.
dialogues.text:
It's been a week since I was released from the hospital. I
can walk without my crutches now.

dialogues.jp:
松葉杖なしに学園へ向かおうとしたのだが、萌
先輩は心配そうだった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to go to school without my crutches, but Moe-sempai
was concerned.
dialogues.text:
I tried to go to school without my crutches, but Moe-sempai
was concerned.

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で、萌先輩が松葉杖を、俺が二人分の
鞄を持って、学園へ行く事にしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
She decided to take my crutches to school, while I held both
of our bags in my hands.
dialogues.text:
She decided to take my crutches to school, while I held both
of our bags in my hands.
